_comment: Configuration file for RAG system with image processing

chunking._comment: Settings for text chunking during document processing
chunking._chunk_size_comment: Maximum number of characters per text chunk
chunking._overlap_comment: Number of overlapping characters between consecutive chunks

retrieval._comment: Settings for retrieving relevant chunks from vector store
retrieval._top_k_comment: Number of most relevant chunks to retrieve for each query
retrieval._normalize_comment: Whether to normalize embeddings for better similarity search

llm._comment: Language model configuration for text generation and embeddings
llm._use_claude_comment: Whether to use Claude (AWS Bedrock) instead of Gemini

gemini._model_comment: Gemini model name for text generation
gemini._embedding_model_comment: Gemini embedding model for text vectorization

claude._comment: Claude model configuration via AWS Bedrock
claude._main_model_comment: Claude model ID for final response generation
claude._image_extraction_model_comment: Claude model ID for analyzing and filtering images

cohere._comment: Cohere model configuration via AWS Bedrock
cohere._embedding_model_comment: Cohere embedding model ID for creating text embeddings
